import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator

# Create DataFrame from the provided data
data = {
    'StichtagDat': ['2024-12-31', '2025-12-31', '2019-12-31', '2020-12-31', '2021-12-31'],
    'StichtagDatJahr': [2024, 2025, 2019, 2020, 2021],
    'AlterV10Lang': ['30- bis 39-Jährige', '30- bis 39-Jährige', '30- bis 39-Jährige', '30- bis 39-Jährige', '30- bis 39-Jährige'],
    'SexLang': ['männlich', 'männlich', 'männlich', 'männlich', 'männlich'],
    'KreisLang': ['Kreis 7', 'Kreis 7', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10', 'Kreis 10'],
    'QuarLang': ['Hottingen', 'Hottingen', 'Höngg', 'Höngg', 'Höngg'],
    'Rasse1Text': ['Deutsche Dogge', 'Deutsche Dogge', 'Continental Bulldog', 'Continental Bulldog', 'Continental Bulldog'],
    'Rasse2Text': ['Labrador Retriever', 'Labrador Retriever', '', '', ''],
    'GebHundDatJahr': [2020, 2020, 2019, 2019, 2019],
    'AlterVHundNum': [4.0, 5.0, 0.0, 1.0, 2.0],
    'SexHundLang': ['männlich', 'männlich', 'männlich', 'männlich', 'männlich'],
    'HundefarbeText': ['beige', 'beige', 'beige/schwarz', 'beige/schwarz', 'beige/schwarz'],
    'AnzHunde': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Dog age distribution by year
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
sns.lineplot(data=df, x='StichtagDatJahr', y='AlterVHundNum', hue='Rasse1Text', 
             marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=8)
ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Dog Age Progression Over Time by Breed', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax1.legend(title='Dog Breed', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax1.xaxis.set_major_locator(MaxNLocator(integer=True))

# 2. Distribution of dog breeds
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(breed_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(breed_counts.values, labels=breed_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax2.set_title('Distribution of Dog Breeds', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Geographic distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
district_data = df.groupby('KreisLang').size().reset_index(name='count')
sns.barplot(data=district_data, x='KreisLang', y='count', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for container in ax3.containers:
    ax3.bar_label(container, fmt='%d', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Dog colors distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts()
sns.barplot(x=color_counts.values, y=color_counts.index, ax=ax4, orient='h')
ax4.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Dog Color', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Distribution of Dog Colors', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
for i, v in enumerate(color_counts.values):
    ax4.text(v + 0.1, i, str(v), va='center', fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
